profiles.name: Ashtar / Athina Król
profiles.classification: Claimed galactic guide; Pleiadian-connected in a 2026 interview description
profiles.origin: Current public brand: Spirit Channel with Athina Król
profiles.datePrecision: Exact publication date; personal origin unresolved
profiles.dateBasis: Dated public Ashtar podcast episode. Her retrospective accounts place psychic experiences in her teens and Ashtar around age 20, without a securely verified calendar year.
profiles.summary: Król presents herself as a trance channel and teacher. Her Ashtar material combines soul-purpose teachings with galactic narratives and personal sovereignty. Her wider catalog also names Isis, the Atlantean Council of Light and the Andromedan Angelic Collective.
claims: She describes receiving communications from Ashtar.
A 2026 interview presents an acceleration narrative for 2027–2030. These are future-oriented spiritual claims, not established events.
caveats: 2023-02-06 is a documented publication, not the first claimed contact.
Ashtar is a shared name across much older channeling traditions; a shared name alone does not establish continuity or a single source.
Her courses and wealth-related offerings are commercial claims. No independent outcome validation was assessed.

profiles.name: Ryok / Ryo / Ryokah
profiles.classification: Claimed Sassani-related consciousness; current official label is hybrid ET
profiles.dateBasis: Ellison dates working with this primary entity to 2019; this is distinct from his earlier general channeling practice.
profiles.summary: The Galactic Guide is Ellison’s public channeling project. Its current offerings mix ET narratives, esoteric teaching, self-development and ritual training. The name variants identify a changing presentation of the same attributed guide.
claims: His detailed biography describes the shift Riok → Ryok → Ryo → Ryokah as an ascension of consciousness.
He describes Ryokah as nonphysical and combining grey, human and angelic qualities; these are his metaphysical descriptions.
caveats: Sassani/Essassani is a claimed civilization label, not an established biological classification.
A dated community repost exists in July 2019; this does not verify a first public upload.
Testimonials and collaborator biographies do not independently establish the claimed entity.

findings: Correct public attribution: Ryok / The Galactic Guide refers to Tyler Ellison, currently branding the guide as Ryokah.
Athina Król is the creator spelling currently used, with Krol as the unaccented version. Do not infer a precise contact year from her age statements.
Origin, practice start, public publication and later retrospective biography are different date types and must remain separate.
Name reuse across Ashtar sources cannot establish a single identity. Likewise, spiritual ET descriptors are source-attributed cosmology, not scientific taxonomy.
Only open public pages and indexed descriptions were accessed. No paid/private sessions, Patreon recordings, or private identities were investigated.
YouTube watch-page access was blocked or throttled. Videos are cataloged from available metadata and descriptions; no full transcripts or audiovisual content were reviewed.
